lane: No-patch survival bridges and source-search packet discipline
publication_decision: Pending workflow DOI refresh. This is reusable method/support documentation, not author-edition material.

local_files.scope: Workflow addendum distinguishing no-patch survival bridges and source-search packets from reader editions, proof, certification, critical editions, and source-fidelity verification.

lessons: No-patch survival bridges are useful anti-regression and stale-queue-prevention evidence, but do not prove fresh page-level source fidelity.
Source-search packets should record source witnesses tried, rejected, or blocked, and should not be promoted as reader editions.
Large raw source archives should be retained by checksum/source-library pointer unless deliberately rolled into a source-support refresh.
Public metadata should label these packets as no-patch, survival, source-routing, or source-quality-blocked where appropriate.
caveat: Workflow/support artifact only. This does not certify Noether or any author record.
next_action: Include this addendum and the updated workflow metadata in the next deliberate workflow DOI refresh.
